subject: maths
title: Linear Combinations and the CLT
welcome_lead: Combine normals and witness the Central Limit Theorem make order from chaos.
meta_desc: HL Maths adventure on linear combinations of normals and the Central Limit Theorem.
final_note: CLT: sample means tend to normal as n grows large!

concepts.def: aX + bY with constants a, b.
Var(aX + bY) = a^2 Var(X) + b^2 Var(Y).
Independent normals sum to a normal.
X̄ has mean μ and variance σ^2/n.
X̄ ≈ N(μ, σ^2/n) for large n.

walkthroughs.body_html:
X ~ N(50, 4), Y ~ N(60, 9), independent. Find Y - X distribution.

Mean 60-50=10, Var = 9+4=13. So Y-X ~ N(10, 13).
